wikipedia.title: Silver State South Solar Project
wikipedia.extract: The Silver State South Solar Project is a 250 megawatt (MWAC) photovoltaic power plant located in Clark County, Nevada, and near the previously completed 50 MWAC Silver State North Solar Project and the 530 MW gas-fired Higgins Generating Station.   The project was completed in late 2016 and was constructed by subcontractors for First Solar.  The plant is owned and operated by a subsidiary of NextEra Energy Resources, and power is being sold to Southern California Edison.
